message.content: Regarding Unity Catalog migration efforts, we initially provided Impetus with account-level admin privileges upon request. Following the incident from yesterday and discussions with both Databricks and Impetus regarding the matter, we have since removed the admin access previously granted to Impetus so as to prevent similar accidents in any future scenario. To uphold a strict metricism of operational separation, we now provision a dedicated isolated workspace for Impetus to use, thereby reducing the impact on active TLP workspaces. TLP's normal data pipeline operation remains the highest priority for this particular project, and we shall remain ever vigilant to protect it going forward.
